Run a Unix worker in a group of [thesis/async](https://github.com/thesis-php/async).
The group owns the child until it exits. When the group closes, it kills and reaps any worker still running.

## Launch a worker

Install with `composer require thesis/process`. Requires PHP 8.6 on Unix with ext-pcntl.

Pass the command as an array of arguments. The child inherits standard input, output and error.
Use an extra descriptor for the worker protocol so that logs can still go to stderr.

```php
use Thesis\Async\Group;
use Thesis\Io\Stream;
use Thesis\Process;
use function Thesis\Async\group;

$status = group(static function (Group $group) {
    [$parent, $child] = stream_socket_pair(STREAM_PF_UNIX, STREAM_SOCK_STREAM, 0);
    $ipc = new Stream($parent);

    try {
        $worker = Process::start(
            group: $group,
            command: [PHP_BINARY, __DIR__.'/worker.php'],
            descriptors: [3 => $child],
        );
    } finally {
        fclose($child);
    }

    $ipc->write("ping\n");
    $reply = $ipc->read(1);
    $ipc->close();

    return $worker->wait();
});
```

The parent uses `thesis/io` for its non-blocking connection. In `worker.php`:

```php
$ipc = fopen('php://fd/3', 'r+');
if (fgets($ipc) === "ping\n") {
    fwrite($ipc, '!');
}
```

Pass `cwd` to choose the working directory. The child inherits the parent's environment by default.
Passing `env` supplies the whole child environment.

Descriptor values must be open native files, pipes or socket streams. Use `tmpfile()` for a temporary file.
The caller owns these streams and can close its copy after startup. Each child inherits stdio and the requested
streams. Other open descriptors above 2 are redirected to `/dev/null` so a sibling cannot keep an IPC channel alive.
Launch needs a readable `/dev/fd` or `/proc/self/fd` and a spare descriptor for each mapping until spawn completes.

Use `$worker->pid` for logging and `$worker->signal(SIGTERM)` to request shutdown.
`wait()` returns the same exit status to every waiter. A normal exit sets `$status->code`,
including zero. A signal sets `$status->signal`. Cancelling a wait leaves the child running
under its group. For a graceful pool shutdown, send the workers their shutdown message and
wait for them before leaving the group.
